evals.prompt: What changed in runxhq/runx since 8am yesterday, Sydney time?
evals.expected_output: Read the issues and pull requests updated since then once, with the signed-in gh session and no approval, and return each in a few fields, newest change first.

evals.prompt: Post this exact review comment to the selected GitHub pull request.
evals.expected_output: Post the approved comment once and return independent GitHub readback for the exact body.

evals.prompt: Post this review comment without a local or hosted GitHub binding.
evals.expected_output: Refuse with one actionable grant error before mutating GitHub.
Read the exact issue with the signed-in account; no synchronization direction, requested scope, store write or mutation.

evals.prompt: List the open triage issues in runxhq/runx using the GitHub account already authenticated on this machine.
evals.expected_output: Read the bounded issue list once with the signed-in gh session, without approval, and return GitHub's issues as provider evidence.

evals.prompt: Label issue 241 in runxhq/runx as triage using the GitHub account signed in on this machine.
evals.expected_output: Apply the one approved label update and confirm it by reading the issue back.

evals.prompt: Open an issue in runxhq/runx titled "Test cases for issue creation", labelled triage, using the GitHub account signed in on this machine.
evals.expected_output: Open the one approved issue and confirm it by reading the new issue back.

evals.prompt: Post the final comment produced by this completed PR review.
evals.expected_output: Reuse the supplied final review body and target, create it once, and return readback without repeating review.
expectations: Do not rerun the pull-request review.
Do not create a second comment when provider readback already proves the mutation.

evals.prompt: Persist the next local GitHub sync plan from the supplied cursor and prior sync evidence.
evals.expected_output: Use the supplied current store version and page-2 cursor to append and read back the local plan without GitHub calls. This is local planning, not remote synchronization.
expectations: Do not repeat provider discovery already covered by the cursor.
Do not reapply completed synchronization mutations.

evals.prompt: Read issue 241 once and use it to draft the next maintainer response.
evals.expected_output: Return the actual source issue to the no-provider triage phase without refetching or posting.
expectations: Do not fetch the issue again inside triage.
Do not post the draft or persist a cursor just to review it.
